highlights: BFSI - NBFCs 1 d Growth Outlook Intact; Asset Quality Recovery Remains Key Est.
Management attributed the deterioration in asset quality mainly to the legacy portfolio, originated before Apr’24, where resolution and recoveries have taken longer than initially anticipated.
Management expects the NBFC asset quality metrics to take another 1-2 quarters to normalise, with gradual improvement expected by the end of FY27.

Considering elevated stress levels in the NBFC business, management has revised consolidated FY27 credit cost guidance upwards by 5-10bps. • Home Loans Asset Quality Remains Resilient: In contrast to the NBFC business, the housing finance franchise continues to demonstrate healthy asset quality, with no meaningful deterioration in underlying portfolio trends.
valuation: Result Update 05th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 250 Aptus Value Housing Finance India Ltd.

The sharp correction in stock has resulted in valuations appearing reasonable given Aptus’ ability to deliver best-in-class RoA of 7.4-7.5% over FY27-FY29E; however, a decisive and sustained recovery in asset quality and consistent execution on growth remain key for stock performance.
Current Valuation: 1.7x Sep’28E ABV; Earlier Valuation: 2.4x FY28E ABV Current TP: Rs 250/share; Earlier TP: Rs 325/share Recommendation: We maintain our BUY recommendation on the stock.
